response.original_title: Wir Sind Am Leben - Das Berlin Musical
response.overview: A new German musical by Peter Plate & Ulf Leo Sommer  After the great successes of Plate & Sommer, the author duo is back with a new Berlin musical – powerful, emotional and full of music that remains.  WE ARE ALIVE is a fast-paced, comic and deeply moving musical about departure, cohesion and joie de vivre. A night of laughing, paused – and laugh again.  A musical that you have to see in Berlin – because this city finds its voice here.
